# heraut changelog

Generate changelog (optionally commit and tag).

Write the changelog for the next version without publishing anything. On its own it only updates
the changelog file; --commit also commits and pushes it, --tag also creates and pushes the tag.
Use it for projects that tag but publish no forge release, or to read the changelog before releasing.

## Usage

```text
heraut changelog [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
# Update CHANGELOG.md, commit nothing
heraut changelog

# Commit, tag and push, without a forge release
heraut changelog --tag

# Commit and tag locally only
heraut changelog --tag --no-push
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--allow-major` |  | confirm a major bump for this run: lift versioning.bump.stay_at_v0 and versioning.bump.confirm_major |
| `--commit` |  | commit the generated changelog |
| `--dry-run` |  | print actions without executing them |
| `--env <string>` |  | target environment (for per-env strategies) |
| `--force` |  | release from here: lift the branch checks and E002 (destination ahead); E001 and missing PR data are never forced |
| `--no-hooks` |  | skip every configured hook (post_bump/pre_changelog/pre_tag/post_tag) for this run |
| `--no-push` |  | commit and tag locally without pushing (only meaningful with --commit/--tag) |
| `--offline` |  | skip remote PR/MR metadata enrichment (forces enrichment_policy: disabled); outside CI, commit links go too |
| `--regenerate` |  | rebuild the entire changelog and re-fetch PR attribution (instead of incrementally adding the new section) |
| `--set-build-id <string>` |  | build ID for the tag: the {build} token in tag_format, or +\<id\> build metadata under plain semver (requires --set-version) |
| `--set-version <string>` |  | override the resolved version — with or without tag prefix (e.g. 1.2.3 or v1.2.3); must match the strategy (SemVer, or the CalVer format) |
| `--skip-hook <strings>` |  | skip individual hook points for this run (post_bump/pre_changelog/pre_tag/post_tag); repeatable or comma-separated, also read from HERAUT_SKIP_HOOKS when the flag is absent; cannot be combined with --no-hooks |
| `--tag` |  | tag after commit (implies --commit) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
